sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Ki *vagy*? asks who you are. *Hol* *laksz*? asks where you live.

Ki vagy? and Hol laksz? are your two best icebreakers, and they share a trick: the question word does the front-loading, so the verb just tags along at the end, unstressed. Practice them as a pair out loud — asking ‘who’ then ‘where’ back-to-back is exactly how real introductions in Hungarian tend to go.
